countries.leaders: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni (Brothers of Italy); President Sergio Mattarella
countries.summary: Meloni's centre-right coalition has governed since 2022 and still leads polls. A new electoral law with a majority bonus for both houses was adopted in October 2026.
